title: Are You on the List of Those Who Will Receive the Blessing of God
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges Western American Christians to wake up from their complacency and take their faith beyond the four walls of the church. He shares a bold vision for spreading the gospel across the globe, using the example of a upcoming mass crusade in Africa, and encourages listeners to examine their own hearts and actions to see if they're truly living for the kingdom of God. Will you be part of the team that God is using to take the good news of the gospel to the nations?
